name: Screen-Space Ambient Occlusion for Volumes
definition: An extension of SSAO to volume rendering that simulates ambient occlusion on surfaces within a volume by extracting position and normal information from the raycasting algorithm to create an opacity isovalue layer.
summary: Screen-Space Ambient Occlusion for Volumes enhances depth perception by applying SSAO to a synthetic opacity layer, distinguishing itself by using screen-space depth comparisons rather than explicit volumetric scattering.
